## Requirements: close the remaining non-token visual-style bypasses repository-wide

### Background
#4045 defines cross-Experience Spatial Relationships. #4050 / PR #4051 now provides real rhythm tokens and a **blocking token-only Gate for named Nession-owned shared Recipes** (ResourceDetail, ConfigurationForm, OperationSurface and their style owner). Existing `visual-vocabulary-source` covers palette/typography/radius/elevation and illegal variable references elsewhere. The user explicitly requires *non-token styles to be forbidden*, not merely documented. However legacy product/capability code still contains many Tailwind scale metrics such as `gap-2`, `p-3` and `mt-4`; claiming whole-repo token-only enforcement at #4050 would be false.

### Scope
- Extend the *same canonical* Design System gate / generated lint metadata / Layout Ownership source, not a second gate or standalone hardcoded value catalog.
- Inventory non-token visual decisions in **all shipping Web/App-owned product/capability/host/renderer-adapter code**: spacing, padding/margin/gap, surface inset, sizes, typographic scales, colors, border/radius/elevation, inline style and CSS declarations.
- Distinguish visual value versus layout mechanism: `flex`, `grid`, `min-w-0`, responsive composition, zero-gap, runtime data-driven dimensions, App touch targets, xterm/CodeMirror/Markdown adapters and upstream shadcn internals have explicit narrow semantic owners.
- Migrate existing hardcoded visual values to canonical Web/App token sources (or approved Nession-owned Recipe). Do not reuse a coincidentally equal but semantically incorrect token. Add a token only when there is a stable owned visual relation, not for every arbitrary local adjacency.
- **Blocking rollout:** existing violations get an auditable inventory and deterministic migration steps. Either migrate to zero before enabling a strict global rule or implement source-aligned additive-only (new/modified code) enforcement with an immutable approved baseline, then ratchet the baseline to zero. No broad ignore, baseline auto-growth, `eslint-disable`, newly-created `--nession-local-*` as an unowned style escape, or unchecked dynamic class interpolation.
- Verify Manual/CI/Hook all consume the same `design-system-fast` and `web-eslint` owner; negative fixtures must fail in both source and ESLint paths where applicable, with file, exact metric, owner and repair.
- Follow #4050’s token owner registry; no duplication of normative spacing matrices or generated CSS editing.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 All shipping visual values that can be statically identified are represented by canonical tokens, approved primitive geometry or narrowly documented/verified renderer-local contracts; inventory tracks intentional exceptions.
- [x] SC-02 Canonical design/source + ESLint gates reject new and modified non-token Tailwind spacing, inline literals and CSS values **across Web/App**, not only known shared recipes. Explicit zero/structural layout and registered adapters still pass.
- [x] SC-03 Full existing debt migrates or is held behind a fail-closed, non-growing audited baseline that cannot be manipulated by an unrelated PR; source-aligned negative mutation tests prove denial, and CI/Hook/manual all run the same gate.
- [ ] SC-04 Browser design/viewport checks confirm no unintended density or responsive regression from token migration; exact-PR-head CI and Case evidence required.
